descs.t: Alberta has voted decisively to stay in Canada, and the result gives Carney backing to take on Donald Trump. We walk through the referendum result and the legal fight over the tariffs.

Alberta's decisive vote to stay in Canada hands Carney a stronger position against Trump's tariffs.
